notes: National Rail (Darwin/OpenLDBWS) is structurally catalogued here but blocked at the account level — DARWIN_LDB_TOKEN not set. Same blocker as every other UK region in this wave.

FIRST MULTI-GROUP REGION: no single hub-lock. Tim's Option A decision (docs/london-se-national-rail-d1/jim-handoff.md) is seven independent per-terminus station groups, no forced merge into one board. Each `stops` entry below is one BOARD, not necessarily one physical station — London Bridge (LBG) and Liverpool Street (LST) each share one physical CRS across multiple entries, split by operator (internal doNotGroup, see hazard-pack.md H4). This is genuine reuse of the existing allow-list catalog shape (entries keyed by name/alias, not forced to be 1:1 with CRS) — no change needed to lib/providers/uk/catalog.js itself.

groupId groups the entries that share one physical station: london-bridge (3 entries, 1 CRS) and liverpool-street (2 entries, 1 CRS). All other entries are groupId === id (their own single-board group).

operators lists the in-scope operator(s) for that specific board. includeOperators (same list) is passed to the shared uk-darwin.js fetchStationBoard() for the two doNotGroup groups only, to split one CRS's Darwin board into per-operator boards — the split is enforced in code (see lib/providers/london-se-national-rail.js), not just documented.

excludeOperators records a board-eligibility exclusion enforced via the shared uk-darwin.js excludeOperators option: Eurostar at St Pancras International (out-checkin), Night Riviera Sleeper at Paddington (out-reservation). LNER at King's Cross was previously excluded pending a verdict; resolved to IN per the UK ledger, 5 Sep 2026 (see docs/united-kingdom-ledger.md §3).

CRS codes are UNVERIFIED against a live GTFS dump or Darwin response — carried from the oracle report's own 'examples' list, crsVerified: false throughout. Confirm before treating as authoritative once Darwin is unblocked.

Euston (regional operator never named in the oracle report) and seven secondary termini (Blackfriars, Cannon Street, Charing Cross, Farringdon, Fenchurch Street, Marylebone, Moorgate, all report-marked TBD) are NOT built — see docs/london-se-national-rail-d1/published-network.json notBuilt.

Regional boundaries flagged, not resolved here: GWR continues west from Paddington into West of England (Bristol Temple Meads); SWR continues southwest from Waterloo (no adjacent region built yet); CrossCountry through-runs nationally. See jim-handoff.md.

stops.name: London Waterloo
stops.class: station group — SWR terminus (southwest, Solent corridor). Single operator, no internal doNotGroup. Part of the seven-group Option A architecture, not a region-wide hub-lock.

stops.name: London Victoria
stops.class: station group — Southern/Gatwick Express (south coast, Gatwick Airport). Same agency family, one board, distinguished by destination+operator, not a doNotGroup case.

stops.name: London Bridge (Southeastern)
stops.class: station group (1 of 3 sharing CRS LBG) — Southeastern board only. Internal doNotGroup: London Bridge has three operators at one physical station with separate boarding sections (Southeastern/Southern/Thameslink); do not merge with the other two London Bridge boards.

stops.name: London Bridge (Southern)
stops.class: station group (2 of 3 sharing CRS LBG) — Southern board only. See London Bridge (Southeastern) for the doNotGroup rationale.

stops.name: London Bridge (Thameslink)
stops.class: station group (3 of 3 sharing CRS LBG) — Thameslink board only. See London Bridge (Southeastern) for the doNotGroup rationale.

stops.name: Liverpool Street (Greater Anglia)
stops.class: station group (1 of 2 sharing CRS LST) — Greater Anglia board only. Internal doNotGroup: Liverpool Street has two operators at one physical station with separate boarding sections (Greater Anglia/c2c); do not merge with the c2c board.

stops.name: Liverpool Street (c2c)
stops.class: station group (2 of 2 sharing CRS LST) — c2c board only. See Liverpool Street (Greater Anglia) for the doNotGroup rationale.

stops.name: London King's Cross
stops.class: station group — Great Northern hub (north via East Coast Main Line, regional). LNER also calls here and is IN per the UK ledger, 5 Sep 2026 (Tim resolved the board-eligibility verdict; previously excluded pending a verdict). See docs/london-se-national-rail-d1/jim-handoff.md for the prior undecided history (immutable) and docs/united-kingdom-ledger.md §3 for the resolution.

stops.name: St Pancras International
stops.class: station group — Thameslink (below-ground). Eurostar also calls here (above-ground) but is EXCLUDED — out-checkin, compulsory pre-departure check-in, international service out of v1 scope by design.

stops.name: London Paddington
stops.class: station group — GWR hub (southwest via Great Western Main Line, Wales). Night Riviera Sleeper also calls here but is EXCLUDED — out-reservation, compulsory reservation for sleeping cars. GWR continues west into the already-built West of England region (Bristol Temple Meads) — through-running only, not a merge point, flagged for D2.
